entries.title: Illustrative translation manager page with source, locale, file, and filter selectors in the no-results state preview.
entries.notes: Illustrative deterministic fixture, not a live Filament resource capture. Capture after installing only the core Capell stack and capell-app/translation-manager, with package_paths restricted to [] in the disposable harness so unrelated local package repositories do not appear as sources.
entries.useCase: An administrator filters the current translation file to a state with no matching rows and still sees the source, locale, file, and filter controls.

entries.title: Illustrative translation comparison grid with source strings, editable target strings, statuses, and entry selection preview.
entries.notes: Illustrative deterministic fixture, not a live Filament resource capture. Seed the application source with an en file and a partial fr file so the grid shows missing and changed entries without relying on another package.
entries.useCase: A translator reviews source strings beside editable target strings, status, and selection controls.

entries.title: Illustrative create locale modal preview.
entries.notes: Illustrative deterministic fixture, not a live Filament resource capture. Open the Create locale header action from /admin/translation-manager.
entries.useCase: A translator opens the Create locale action to add a new target locale.

entries.title: Illustrative duplicate locale modal preview.
entries.notes: Illustrative deterministic fixture, not a live Filament resource capture. Open the Duplicate locale header action from /admin/translation-manager after en and fr locales exist.
entries.useCase: A translator opens the Duplicate locale action to copy strings from an existing locale.

entries.title: Illustrative translate selected action visible with ai translator support preview.
entries.notes: Illustrative deterministic fixture, not a live Filament resource capture. Requires an available TranslationAITranslator binding, typically through the optional AI Orchestrator integration.
entries.useCase: A translator runs or reviews the Translate selected action when an AI translator binding is available.

entries.title: Illustrative dirty and missing translation review state preview.
entries.notes: Illustrative deterministic fixture, not a live Filament resource capture. Seed a source locale update after a target locale was translated so the grid shows both missing entries and stale/dirty target strings.
entries.useCase: A translator prioritises rows where source copy has changed or target copy has not been supplied yet.

entries.title: Illustrative translation import and export actions preview.
entries.notes: Illustrative deterministic fixture, not a live Filament resource capture. Open the CSV/PO/XLIFF import or export action with en and fr locales seeded, showing format selection and source/target locale controls.
entries.useCase: A localisation manager moves translation work through external CAT tools and back into Capell.

entries.title: Illustrative ai translation suggestion review preview.
entries.notes: Illustrative deterministic fixture, not a live Filament resource capture. Requires TranslationAITranslator or AI Orchestrator integration. Capture generated suggestions before they are accepted into editable target strings.
entries.useCase: A translator reviews AI-assisted copy and keeps human approval in the workflow.

entries.title: Illustrative locale publish readiness summary preview.
entries.notes: Illustrative deterministic fixture, not a live Filament resource capture. Seed complete, missing, and stale locale states so the readiness summary shows which locales can be published safely.
entries.useCase: An editor checks whether a locale is ready to ship before making translated content visible.
